inputs.text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that may be a reassuring figure distracting from the worsening situation: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and national emergency accommodation numbers have climbed again. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 may be contributing to this, rather than showing that the crisis is being solved. The focus is on more tenancies instead of asking who is being pushed out—and why.

output.main_topic: Worsening eviction and homelessness despite increased tenancies
subtopics: Possible effects of six-year lease rules
